notes: Ethereum mainnet (chainId 1). NUKE has no constructor args and mints 1e27 units to its deployer; the launch factory handles the 90% pool / 10% swarm allocation and remainderTo. NUKEHook constructor args are IPoolManager $poolManager (mainnet 0x000000000004444c5dc75cB358380D2e3dE08A90) and address $token. Deploy the hook itself via CREATE2 with address & 0x3fff == 0x20c4 (8388). Static 12500 LP fee plus 100 bps hook fee on the actual unspecified BalanceDelta in afterSwap; no beforeSwap delta or LP override. Fees accrue as ERC-6909 claims. Anyone may sweep NUKE to DEAD or execute an hourly batch spending at most 25% of pending IMD within a 3% adverse price limit based on the last completed hour's time-weighted eligible tick and tightened by current spot when active liquidity is nonzero. Empty-region ticks are not adopted by the oracle. Partial fills retain unspent IMD; zero-output batches roll back without spending funds or consuming the interval. Batch swaps pay only the pool LP fee and send all bought NUKE to DEAD. The initialPrice is provenance only; the factory sets the economic opening price. No owner, setters, proxy, or upgradeability.
